_comment: Minimal synthetic fixture: one load sample per active instance. values are requests_per_second. observed_at is RFC3339; omit it at ingest time to mean 'now'.

missing_instance._comment: ins-0002 sends nothing: measured 20 + imputed 100 = 120; shrink refused

delayed_or_stale._comment: high values reported with observed_at 90s in the past (> 60s freshness): must NOT scale up

short_spike._comment: brief 300 load grows to rate cap 6; an immediate return to 10 cannot shrink until the 5m window elapses
